beats.title: Zhang Qian Rides West for the Han
beats.description: A Han envoy set out across the steppe to seek allies against the nomads, and was held captive for years on the way.

beats.title: Cleopatra Meets Antony at Tarsus
beats.description: The Egyptian queen sailed up the river in a gilded barge to meet the Roman general and win him as an ally.

beats.title: Roman Envoys Reach the Han Court
beats.description: Travellers claiming to represent a Roman emperor reached the Chinese capital by sea and presented ivory and horn.

beats.title: Pope Leo Meets Attila
beats.description: A Roman bishop led a delegation to the Hun king's camp and persuaded him to turn back from marching on the city.

beats.title: Pope Stephen Crosses to Pepin
beats.description: A pope fleeing the Lombards crossed the Alps to seek the protection of the Frankish king, who met him on the road.
beats.note: Left Rome 753; met Pepin at Ponthion in January 754.

beats.title: Elephant Gift Reaches Charlemagne
beats.description: The caliph's gift of an elephant named Abul-Abbas arrived at the Frankish emperor's court after a long journey.

beats.title: Ibn Fadlan's Embassy to the Volga
beats.description: A caliph's envoy travelled north to the king of the Volga Bulgars and left a vivid account of the Norse traders he met.

beats.title: Olga of Kiev Visits Constantinople
beats.description: The ruler of the Rus travelled to the imperial city and was received with ceremony by the Byzantine emperor.
beats.why_in: visit of a ruler to a foreign court
beats.note: Book of Ceremonies records the reception in 957; Primary Chronicle gives 955 or 957.

beats.title: Henry IV Humbles Himself at Canossa
beats.description: A German king stood barefoot in the snow for days outside a castle to beg the pope to lift his excommunication.

beats.title: Carpini Reaches the Great Khan
beats.description: A Franciscan friar sent by the pope crossed Asia to attend the enthronement of the Mongol ruler and deliver a letter.
beats.why_in: papal mission to a foreign ruler

beats.title: Rabban Sauma Reaches Europe
beats.description: A Chinese-born Nestorian monk sent by the Mongol Il-Khan met kings and the pope seeking an alliance against Muslim rivals.

beats.title: Manuel II Visits London
beats.description: The Byzantine emperor toured the courts of the West begging for help against the Ottomans and was feasted by the English king.

beats.title: Clavijo's Embassy Meets Timur
beats.description: A Castilian envoy was received in a pavilion at Samarkand by the conqueror, and wrote a famous account of the journey.

beats.title: Da Gama Is Received at Calicut
beats.description: The Portuguese captain arrived on India's Malabar coast and was granted an audience with the local Zamorin ruler.

beats.title: Cortes Meets Moctezuma
beats.description: The Spanish captain and the Aztec emperor met on the causeway into the lake city of Tenochtitlan.

beats.title: Field of the Cloth of Gold
beats.description: The kings of England and France met amid lavish tents and tournaments in a show of friendship and rivalry.

beats.title: Chancellor Opens Trade with Muscovy
beats.description: An English captain seeking a northern route to Asia landed on the White Sea and was summoned to the Russian ruler's court.
beats.note: Arrived at the White Sea 1553; the Moscow audience is dated 1553 or 1554.

beats.title: Japanese Boy Envoys Meet the Pope
beats.description: Four young Japanese nobles trained by Jesuits reached Rome after years at sea and were received in grand ceremony.

beats.title: Matteo Ricci Enters Beijing
beats.description: A Jesuit scholar with clocks and maps gained entry to the Forbidden City and an audience with the Ming emperor's court.

beats.title: Hasekura Tsunenaga Visits Rome
beats.description: A samurai sent by a Japanese lord crossed the Pacific and Atlantic to meet the pope and the king of Spain.

beats.title: Siamese Embassy to Louis XIV
beats.description: Envoys of the king of Siam arrived at Versailles in splendid costume, dazzling the French court.

beats.title: Peter the Great's Grand Embassy
beats.description: The young Russian tsar toured Western Europe incognito, working in shipyards and meeting kings to modernise his country.

beats.title: Four Mohawk Kings Meet Queen Anne
beats.description: Four Native American leaders were received in London by the monarch, drew crowds and sought help against the French.

beats.title: Macartney's Mission to Qianlong
beats.description: A British lord refused to kowtow before the Chinese emperor and left without winning the trade concessions he sought.

beats.title: Congress of Vienna Opens
beats.description: Diplomats and monarchs gathered to redraw the map of Europe after the fall of the French emperor, amid balls and intrigue.

beats.title: Amherst's Embassy to Beijing
beats.description: A second British mission to the Chinese emperor ended in failure after a dispute over court ceremony.

beats.title: Iwakura Mission Tours the West
beats.description: A large delegation of Japanese leaders visited America and Europe to study modern states and seek treaty revision.

beats.title: Congress of Berlin
beats.description: European powers met under Bismarck's chairmanship to revise the settlement forced on the Ottomans and settle Balkan borders.

beats.title: Edward VII Charms Paris
beats.description: The British king's state visit to the French capital thawed old hostility and paved the way for a famous friendly accord.

beats.title: Kaiser and Tsar Meet at Bjorko
beats.description: Two emperors met on a yacht in the Baltic and secretly signed a defensive pact that their ministers soon rejected.

beats.title: Chamberlain Meets Hitler at Munich
beats.description: Leaders of Britain, France, Italy and Germany met and agreed to hand over a border region of Czechoslovakia.

beats.title: Tehran Conference
beats.description: Roosevelt, Churchill and Stalin met together for the first time to coordinate strategy against the Axis.

beats.title: Yalta Conference
beats.description: The Big Three met in a Crimean resort to plan the postwar order in Europe and the creation of the United Nations.

beats.title: Geneva Summit
beats.description: Leaders of the four great powers met in Switzerland, the first such gathering of East and West since the war ended.

beats.title: Khrushchev Tours America
beats.description: The Soviet leader made a cross-country visit to the United States, touring a farm and Hollywood and meeting the president.

beats.title: Kennedy Meets Khrushchev in Vienna
beats.description: The young American president and the Soviet premier held a tense two-day summit that left Kennedy shaken.

beats.title: Nixon Visits China
beats.description: An American president stepped off his plane in Beijing and shook hands with Chinese leaders after decades of estrangement.

beats.title: Sadat Visits Jerusalem
beats.description: The Egyptian president flew to Israel and addressed its parliament, the first Arab leader to make such a visit.

beats.title: Reagan and Gorbachev at Reykjavik
beats.description: The American and Soviet leaders met in an Icelandic house and nearly agreed to abolish all nuclear weapons.

beats.title: Malta Summit
beats.description: The American and Soviet leaders met aboard ships in a stormy Mediterranean harbour as the Eastern Bloc crumbled.
